The ResizeObserver dedup destructured `contentRect` from every entry before
checking its target, so a mock that delivers entries without it threw inside
the observer callback. Radix's test setup does exactly that, which failed
193 of its tests; 1.8.0 only read `target` and tolerated it. Read the size
only once the entry is known to be the floating
